setup.title: Get your agent ready
setup.description: Each step makes Ollie's answers better. Optional steps help but aren't needed.
setup.completeBody: Ollie has what it needs. Keep improving it with the playground and the questions below.

ai_on.title: Turn on AI
ai_on.why: Ollie needs AI switched on for the workspace before it can answer anyone.

identity.title: Name your agent and tell it how to help
identity.why: A name, a picture and instructions make answers sound like your team.

knowledge.title: Give it something to know
knowledge.why: Ollie answers only from published help articles and ready knowledge sources.

tools.title: Connect tools
tools.why: Let Ollie look up orders or accounts in your own systems.

playground.title: Test it in the playground
playground.why: Ask a few real questions and check the answers before visitors do.

widget.title: Install the chat widget
widget.why: Visitors reach Ollie through the widget on your site.

answers_on.title: Let Ollie answer chats
answers_on.why: Turn on answers so Ollie replies to visitors and hands off when it should.

email_answers.title: Answer email too
email_answers.why: Turn on Ollie for a mailbox to draft or send email replies.

clients.title: AI clients
clients.description: Use opendesk from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code and other MCP clients. They work your tickets, contacts and help articles with the access you give them.
clients.serverHint: Clients that sign in with OAuth need only this address.
clients.setupHint: Pick your client and follow the steps.

steps.claude: In Claude, open Settings, then Connectors, and choose Add custom connector. Paste the URL and select Connect. Sign in to opendesk and approve.
steps.chatgpt: In ChatGPT, add a connector in developer mode with this URL and OAuth authentication. Sign in to opendesk and approve.
steps.claudeCode: Run this in your terminal. Claude Code opens opendesk to sign in the first time you use the server.
steps.claudeCodeKey: Or send an API key as a header instead of signing in:
steps.claudeDesktop: Prefer a connector with sign-in (see Claude). To use an API key, open Settings, then Developer, then Edit config, add this and restart Claude Desktop. It needs Node.js.
steps.cursor: Add this to ~/.cursor/mcp.json for all projects, or .cursor/mcp.json for one. Then check Cursor Settings, MCP.
steps.vscode: Add this as .vscode/mcp.json in your workspace. VS Code asks for the key the first time and stores it securely.
steps.other: Any client that speaks Streamable HTTP works: with OAuth if it supports the MCP authorization spec, otherwise with an API key in the Authorization header.

clients.keyNeeded: This client sends an API key in a header.
clients.keyAskAdmin: Ask an admin to create an API key for it.
clients.keyShownOnce: Copy it now. It's shown once and filled into the snippets above until you leave this page.

keyDialog.title: Create an API key for an AI client
keyDialog.description: The client gets only the tools these scopes allow.
keyDialog.name: Name
keyDialog.readHint: Search and read tickets, contacts and articles.
keyDialog.writeHint: Also reply, add notes, update tickets and draft articles.

clients.toolsHint: A client sees a tool only when its access includes the tool's scopes.
clients.connectionsHint: Clients connected with sign-in. They act as the person who connected them.
clients.connectionsHintAdmin: Clients connected with sign-in, for every member. They act as the person who connected them.
clients.revokeBody: It stops working right away and needs to sign in again to reconnect.
clients.emptyBody: Add opendesk as a connector in Claude or ChatGPT with the URL above. It shows up here once you approve it.
clients.emptyTipSignIn: Sign in, no key to copy
clients.emptyTipRole: Never more than your role allows

consent.title: Connect {{name}} to opendesk
consent.subtitle: {{name}} wants to work in opendesk as you.
consent.notIncluded: Not included: your role in this workspace can't do this
consent.noScopes: Your role in this workspace can't use any of this. Choose another workspace or ask an admin.
consent.redirect: After you decide, you go back to {{host}}.
consent.redirectLocal: After you decide, you go back to an app on this computer ({{host}}).
consent.trust: Only connect apps you trust. You can disconnect it any time in Settings, AI clients.
consent.expiredBody: It expired or was already answered. Start again from your AI client.
consent.invalidBody: The connection request is not valid. Start again from your AI client, or ask its developer for help.
consent.noWorkspaceTitle: You're not in a workspace yet
consent.noWorkspaceBody: Create or join a workspace, then connect the app again.
